node.statement: There is a complex-linear functional phi:A->C with ||phi||=1, phi(J)=1, and phi(x^dagger)=overline(phi(x)) for every x. Indeed, complex Hahn-Banach gives a norm-one complex-linear psi with psi(J)=1. The map psi_sharp(x)=overline(psi(x^dagger)) is complex-linear of norm one, and phi=(psi+psi_sharp)/2 has norm at most one, is Hermitian, and takes value one at the norm-one vector J; therefore ||phi||=1.
